description: This source file implements functionality for pruning packed objects in a Git repository. It includes functions to remove loose objects, display progress, and handle dry-run and verbose options.

methods.name: int prune_subdir(unsigned int nr,const char * path,void * data)
methods.description: Progressively removes directories of loose objects unless in dry run mode, updating progress display.

methods.name: int prune_object(const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)
methods.description: Removes or prints removal of a loose object file based on options, skipping objects already in pack files.

methods.name: void prune_packed_objects(int opts)
methods.description: Main entry point for pruning packed objects with verbosity and dry-run options.

ctags.name: prune_object
ctags.pattern: /^static int prune_object(const struct object_id *oid, const char *path,$/
ctags.signature: (const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)

ctags.name: prune_subdir
ctags.pattern: /^static int prune_subdir(unsigned int nr, const char *path, void *data)$/
